description: Fix the broken agent-creation entry points on the /agents list page: both the 'New Agent' header button and the empty-state 'Create Agent' button navigate to the non-existent /agents/new route. Repoint both to open the existing AgentProfileEditor dialog in create mode via local state, with regression coverage.

tasks.title: Wire /agents create entry points to open AgentProfileEditor dialog
tasks.description: In `packages/web/src/pages/agent-list/ui/AgentListPage.tsx`, add `const [editorOpen, setEditorOpen] = useState(false)` and replace both `navigate(toProjectPath('/agents/new'))` calls — the 'New Agent' header button (testid `agent-list-create`) and the `AgentEmptyState` 'Create Agent' button (testid `agents-empty-create`) — with `setEditorOpen(true)`. Conditionally mount `AgentProfileEditor` with `agent={null}` (create mode) via `{editorOpen && <AgentProfileEditor agent={null} open={editorOpen} onClose={() => setEditorOpen(false)} />}`, mirroring the established `AgentDetailPage` pattern. Rely on the editor's existing create-mode contract (invalidates `['agents']` and navigates to the new agent's detail page on success); the list page performs no navigation. Remove any now-dead imports introduced by dropping the two navigations. Update `AgentListPage.test.tsx` to mock `AgentProfileEditor` with a lightweight stub exposing testid `agent-profile-editor`, and add regression specs asserting that clicking each create entry point surfaces the editor stub in the DOM with the URL unchanged (no navigation to `/agents/new`), replacing any prior assertion on route changes.
acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the 'New Agent' header button (testid `agent-list-create`) opens the AgentProfileEditor dialog (testid `agent-profile-editor`) in create mode instead of navigating.
Clicking the empty-state 'Create Agent' button (testid `agents-empty-create`) opens the AgentProfileEditor dialog (testid `agent-profile-editor`) in create mode instead of navigating.
Neither create entry point changes the URL or requests `/agents/new` (no 404 navigation).
The editor is conditionally rendered (mounted only while open), so closing and reopening it from either entry point presents empty form fields with no carried-over input or validation state.
On a successful create, the `['agents']` query is invalidated (list refreshes) and the user is routed to `/agents/<new-agent-id>` by the editor — the list page itself performs no navigation.
`AgentListPage.test.tsx` contains regression specs for both entry points asserting the editor stub appears on click with no route change, and contains no assertion on navigation to `/agents/new`.
`npm run typecheck -w packages/web` passes with no dead-import or unused-variable errors.
`npm run test:run -w packages/web` passes, including the new and existing agent-list specs.
tasks.output: Updated `packages/web/src/pages/agent-list/ui/AgentListPage.tsx` (editorOpen state + conditional AgentProfileEditor mount, both create handlers repointed, dead imports removed) and `packages/web/src/pages/agent-list/ui/AgentListPage.test.tsx` (stubbed-editor regression specs for both entry points).
tasks.notes: Single-file UI wiring fix; no API, persistence, schema, or route-table changes. Reuses the existing AgentProfileEditor create-mode contract — do not modify AgentProfileEditor, AgentDetailPage, or App.tsx. The editor's create-mode success behavior (query invalidation + navigate-on-success) is covered by its own specs; the list-page spec should stub the editor and assert only the open/close wiring. Verify `useNavigate`/`useProjectPath` are still used by AgentRow before removing imports — only drop truly dead ones.
